content: SigNoz Foundry: install foundryctl via curl -fsSL https://signoz.io/foundry.sh | bash. Workflow: foundryctl gauge -f casting.yaml (validate prereqs like docker/compose), foundryctl forge -f casting.yaml (generate compose files into pours/deployment/, writes casting.yaml.lock with checksums for reproducible re-apply), foundryctl cast -f casting.yaml (full pipeline: gauge+forge+deploy, runs docker compose up -d). Minimal casting.yaml: apiVersion v1alpha1, kind Installation, spec.deployment.mode=docker, flavor=compose. foundryctl gen generates example casting files.
